answer: Resist sybils with postal-address attestation: each identity must claim one physical address, to which the network mails a one-time code that must be entered within days. A zenith of standing is unreachable by software alone, since every address is checked against utility records and duplicate households are flagged. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes needs ten thousand real mailboxes, each opal-tagged with a lease and a human who can receive mail, paying rent and postage per fake. Mass forgery becomes sable-dark physical logistics, while an honest agent confirms one address once.
